subject: SIG questionnaire — timeline & deliverables for Horizon Payments
messages:
From: Alex Trevor <security@horizonpay.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SIG questionnaire for Horizon Payouts — target 2026-03-06

Hi Rishi / Marissa,

We're kicking off the security review for Horizon Payouts. Attached is our standard SIG package — we'd like Redwood's completed responses and evidence by 2026-03-06 so our internal reviewers can meet the quarterly intake.

Key asks:
- Completed SIG spreadsheet (the XLSX)
- SOC 2 summary / report or evidence links
- Network diagram and vendor subprocessor list

Can you confirm you can meet 3/6? If not, what partial deliverables can you provide by then?

Thanks,
Alex Trevor
Security Programs
Horizon Payments

[Attachment: Horizon_SIG_Request.pdf]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire for Horizon Payouts — target 2026-03-06

Thanks Alex — received.

Marissa / Dev — can you own the SIG? Marissa, do you have bandwidth to coordinate evidence collection and hit the 3/6 date? Dev, please flag any items that need engineering input (network, SOC artifacts).

Proposed mutual action plan:
- This week: review SIG spreadsheet and mark items we can answer immediately
- Next week (by 3/6): submit completed spreadsheet + SOC2 summary + network diagram; if some items need extra time, we provide partial responses and a plan for the remainder

Marissa — if you want, I can reply to Alex with a short status and confirm the proposed plan.

Rishi
VP, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 08:29:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire for Horizon Payouts — proposed plan

Rishi / Dev — I'm on it. Quick status and ask list:

Status:
- Downloaded Horizon_SIG_Request.pdf and started a copy of the SIG workbook (attached).
- I can complete ~70% of the spreadsheet this week (policies, process-level controls, org Qs).

Outstanding items for engineering/legal:
- SOC2 report (we can provide SOC2 summary now; full report requires legal check)
- Network diagram and details on VPC peering / egress — Dev, can you provide a diagram and brief narrative?
- Subprocessor list: Product team to confirm current list (I have a partial list)

Attachments: SIG_Horizon_workbook.xlsx (working copy).

If Horizon is strict about a firm 3/6 cutoff, let's provide the spreadsheet + SOC2 summary + network diagram by 3/6 and indicate a follow-up for the remaining subprocessor confirmations and a couple of process artifacts.

Next steps:
1) Dev: share network architecture + any redactions needed for sensitive IP (due 3/3)
2) Legal: quick review of SOC2 summary and the request for the full report (Marissa to loop legal if needed)
3) I'll assemble and send partial deliverables to Horizon 3/6 if we can't complete every single cell.

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Accounts, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SIG_Horizon_workbook.xlsx]

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 14:11:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire for Horizon Payouts — network diagram + SOC update

Marissa / Rishi — status from eng: 

- Attached: high-level network diagram (network_arch.png) and a 1-page SOC2 summary (SOC2_Summary.pdf). The network diagram includes VPC layout, gateways, and outbound egress flows — we've redacted internal hostnames.
- Subprocessor list: I only have an engineering view (infra vendors). I'll need product ops to confirm SaaS dependencies (due 3/5).

Open items that may slip past 3/6:
- Full SOC2 report: legal needs to approve sharing the full report with Horizon (I estimate legal signoff by 3/9)
- Vendor contracts/subprocessor confirmations: 3/9 as well unless product ops prioritizes earlier

If Horizon will accept the SIG workbook + SOC2 summary + network diagram by 3/6, we'll deliver that. Otherwise we should request a short extension.

Dev Patel
Engineering Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: network_arch.png]
[Attachment: SOC2_Summary.pdf]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Alex Trevor <security@horizonpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire for Horizon Payouts — status update and partial delivery plan

Alex — quick status from Redwood: thanks for the request and the deadline. We can deliver the following by 2026-03-06:

- Completed SIG workbook (most non-engineering cells populated)
- SOC2 one-page summary (attached)
- High-level network diagram (attached)

Outstanding (target 2026-03-09):
- Full SOC2 report (legal review)
- Confirmed subprocessor list (product ops sign-off)

If Horizon can accept the above partial package by 3/6 with the remainder on 3/9, we'll proceed that way. Otherwise we can request a firm extension to 3/9 to hand everything over at once. Which would you prefer?

Thanks — we'll be responsive to whichever cadence you need.

Rishi Malhotra
VP, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOC2_Summary.pdf]

From: Alex Trevor <security@horizonpay.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire for Horizon Payouts — acceptance of partial deliverables

Rishi / team — thanks for the rapid coordination and the clear plan. Horizon can accept the partial package by 2026-03-06 (SIG workbook + SOC2 summary + network diagram). Please include any rows you cannot complete with a short note and an estimated completion date.

We'll expect the remaining items (full SOC2 report share & complete subprocessor confirmations) by 2026-03-09. To make sure things stay on track, can we set a brief 15-minute weekly sync (Tuesdays) until the package is fully closed? If so, please send a calendar invite.

Appreciate the partnership — Alex
Alex Trevor
Security Programs, Horizon Payments
[Attachment: Horizon_SIG_Request.pdf (original)]
